# Closed capture: a loop whose every level reads only the share

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`closed-capture` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](closed-capture.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects, a loss the loop does not read leaves it locked however large it grows, and a change of the reading is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. What the loop does not read does not change it: on Pace's two-level course with the fast configuration a pair, the share and what lies beyond it, where neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond (Unread), courses from starts alike in share and rule stay alike in both; courses that come apart read beyond the share; the share's law joined with a step beyond runs exactly as the share's law alone. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Unread`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.turn_unread`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.unread_course`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.reads_beyond_of_apart`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.join`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.joinRead`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.join_unread`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.join_alike`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.turn_join`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.join_course`)
2. The loop reads only the share exactly where what it reads makes sense alone: share, rule and step count (loopPart) go alike under the two-level step where Unread holds; they make sense by themselves along every schedule, and courses alike in share and rule stay alike along every schedule, exactly where Unread holds. This is IdentificationRuns' law of a part read alone. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.loopPart`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.goAlike_of_unread`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.identifiesAlike_iff_unread`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.courses_alike_iff_unread`)
3. A locked loop outlives its loss: where every step adds at least one to what lies beyond (Accrues), from a locked configuration the loss at step t is at least t above where it started, so it passes every bound, while the course stays locked and neither the share nor the rule is ever below where it started. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Accrues`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.loss_grows`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`)
4. A reading that reads the loss turns: where the rule read favours at no configuration whose loss is at least N, and every step adds at least one, at the step after every reading step at which the loss has passed N the rule in force does not favour, so the course is not locked there, whatever the share. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.turned_by_loss`)
5. The reading read from the share: where how the rule is read is formed from the share at the reading step (mind) and the rule read from the share through it (read), monotonically, rule and reading are one rule read from the share in the order of pairs; locked, none of share, rule and reading falls below where it was; a change of the reading, either way, the rule still favouring, is absorbed at the next reading step. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.both`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.readers`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.byRule`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.both_reads`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.byRule_raises`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.both_upper`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.readers_not_below`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.reading_absorbed`)
6. Where the rule read favours at every reading and every share, every course is locked from the step after its second reading step, whatever rule and reading it starts with: within a loop whose every level reads only the share, what leaves is a change of the law, such as a level reading beyond the share. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.readers_uniform_locks`)
7. Witnesses: carriers two to one under a rule favouring them four to one, read at every step, each step adding one to the loss; read from the share alone the course is locked at every step, read from the loss the same selection and start favour the others from the second step and the share falls at the third. The reading formed as the share's own proportion meets every premise, and a reading reversed is absorbed. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.lossStep`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.closedRead`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.lossRead`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.closed`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.opened`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.closed_locked`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.lossRead_turns`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.open_turned`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.open_falls`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Beyond.open_reads`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.mind`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.read`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.readMono`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.formed`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.start_locked`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Proportional.reform_absorbed`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each statement names its hypotheses: Unread (neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond); Accrues (each step adds at least one beyond); RuleCapture's Raises, ReadsShare and favouring kept upward; a locked start; for the readings, the reading formed monotonically from the share (ReadsShare on mind) and the rule read monotonically from the reading and the share.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That any actual rule, or how it is read, is formed from the share it selects: this is the premise ReadsShare, on the rule and on mind.
- That what lies beyond the share is a loss to any formation: that is a significance's to say; here it is a count the loop does not read. Nor how fast it grows beyond one a step.
- That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58).
- Real-valued shares, noisy or partial readings, readings that read both the share and part of what lies beyond, and the calibration of any of this to the present world.
- **Counterexample:** Without Unread the loop does not outlive its loss: the same selection from the same locked start, read from the loss instead of the share, favours the others from the second step and its share falls at the third (Beyond.open_turned, Beyond.open_falls). <a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The meta-attractor (theories/meta-attractor): its 2025-08 formalisation separates the state and the rule that scores it, with the rule updated from the state; partial reform re-absorbed is perturbation_absorbed and reading_absorbed, and the metric surviving its own refutation is lock_outlives_loss. Goodhart (1975) says a measure made a target stops measuring; this states why it is kept: what keeps it reads the share it gives, not what it fails to measure. Lock-in under increasing returns (Arthur 1989) and regulatory capture (Stigler 1971) are the closest prior results; the delta is the reading itself read from the share, and the exact condition (Unread) under which a loss leaves the lock. In supervisory control the loop's condition is observability under a reading of the joined whole, the reader inside the plant (Wakaiki, Tabuada and Hespanha 2019, Theorem 4.1); for a reward read through a channel the loop forms, a consistent corruption is indistinguishable from none and a reading the loop does not form is the way out (Everitt, Krakovna, Orseau and Legg 2017, Theorems 11 and 19); for a rule learned from what it admits, closed-loop identifiability (Borkar and Varaiya 1979). On the spine Unread is exactly the law of a part read alone (identifiesAlike_iff_unread), the lumping law that also settles what a learner identifies.

  - Output: A part read alone carries a law, and fixes its own future, exactly where the rest makes no difference to its next value.
